name: Paula Puro
bio: Paula Puro is a Romani and Finnish actress and model. She was born on May 31, 2003, in Sweden. Paula originally began her acting journey at the age of 11, regularly taking theatre classes and performing in numerous plays and projects. In 2019, at the age of 16, she enrolled in theatre and acting studies with a specialisation in directing at the Fine Arts school of Sturegymnasiet in Halmstad, Sweden. Enamored with the arts of the screen, Paula sought a career in film acting during 2023 as she relocated to Paris, France and has since then worked on many projects, such as with her leading role in It's Time To Grow Up, as well as other credits, such as in the American feature film The Gallerist, TV series Merteuil, Emily in Paris, Privilèges, La Maison, amongst others.

credits.title: It's Time to Grow Up
credits.overview: Shortly before her birthday dinner, attended by her immediate family, Margaret, a highly sensitive young girl, writes a phrase once whispered to her by her grandmother in her private journal: “It’s Time to Grow Up.”

credits.title: The Gallerist
credits.overview: Set against the glittering excess of Art Basel Miami, a desperate gallery owner conspires to pass off an accidental corpse as the centerpiece of her debut show.
